source_revision: The commit containing this evidence directory

minio.build: go install github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20250907161309-07c3a429bfed; built locally from pinned official source, not a release binary

environment.proxy_scope: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY removed case-insensitively from the command subprocess environment only; global configuration unchanged

scope: Authoritative grant-chain validation at ICS decision, TCS admission/local-tx and executor send gates. Three-level chains imported through trusted SQL fixtures; public root issuance remains depth zero. No CreateSubtask, cross-owner subject/actor separation, recipient-policy persistence, budget transfer or complete M1/M2 exit established. Repeated benchmark covers root paths only and does not measure chain-depth cost or causal performance differences from the previous run.
development_note: Initial compile-only execution test launch hit a Windows executable sharing error; later full execution tests passed. Vet found an invalid test assertion referring to a nonexistent protobuf field, corrected before runtime tests. First new chain fixtures failed the existing task_version trigger because fixture task-tree updates omitted version increments; fixed fixture setup, then targeted chain/send tests passed. This retained final run used frozen final sources and a fresh isolated cluster; all gates passed without assertion or measurement retry.
